definitions.explanation: The financial means by which a person or household supports daily life. Focuses on the economic aspect of making a living rather than the occupation itself.

examples.japanese: {生計|せいけい}を{立|た}てるのが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to make a living.

examples.japanese: {夫婦|ふうふ}{共働|ともばたら}きで{生計|せいけい}を{立|た}てている。
examples.english: The couple supports their livelihood with both spouses working.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{亡|な}くなってから、{母|はは}が{一人|ひとり}で{家族|かぞく}の{生計|せいけい}を{支|ささ}えてきた。
examples.english: Since my father passed away, my mother has been supporting the family's livelihood on her own.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the expression {生計|せいけい}を{立|た}てる (to make a living, to earn one's livelihood). The word focuses on the financial/economic side of sustaining life, unlike {生業|なりわい} which emphasizes the type of work.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {生計|せいけい}を{立|た}てる: to make a living (most common pattern)
- {生計|せいけい}を{支|ささ}える: to support one's livelihood
- {生計|せいけい}を{共|とも}にする: to share a household (live together financially)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生計|せいけい}を{立|た}てる: to make a living
- {生計|せいけい}を{維持|いじ}する: to maintain one's livelihood
- {生計|せいけい}{手段|しゅだん}: means of livelihood
- {生計|せいけい}{費|ひ}: living expenses
